items.name: einstein-arena
items.description: A local-search lab that reached a server-verified, honest #1 at submission on EinsteinArena's Prime Number Theorem problem, using multiscale supports and an LP engine, built by an agent in Claude Code under a human approval gate; Existence Proof Format instance #1.

items.name: two-deletion-code-16
items.description: Search for large binary two-deletion-correcting codes of length 16, with independent verifiers and reproducible results. An AI-assisted search project (Claude) for the EinsteinArena open problem.

items.name: CodexProLong

items.name: pnt-ceiling-certificates
items.description: Certified exact-rational ceiling theorems for a Mertens-type extremal program (the EinsteinArena PNT benchmark), via weak-duality dual certificates. make verify reproduces both bounds. Third in a series.
